MCalc 1.2.0 — everything from 1.2.0 beta with additions and fixes.

New

- **Hex code**: Color wheel supports setting hex code that syncs with it

Fixes

- Fractional digits past precision fractional digits are rounded so results from expressions like
  sin(pi^2)+cos(pi^2) are equal to 1 and not 0.999 repeating
- Colors for custom presets are altered a bit for better visual experience

Under the hood

- Added more tests
